entry.content:
MathJax macro redefinition allows overriding built-in operatorsNEW

Abusing the MathJax library in GitHub to override built-in operators. The library writes user-defined TeX macros into a persistent new-Command map that is consulted ahead of the built-ins, with no existence check, so a redefined sum macro shadows the native operator across every expression rendered by that input-jax instance.
